items.title: Interop frictions emerging between modular OEMs and legacy control systems
items.lede: Signals indicate testing failures and integration hiccups where new modular inverter and protection systems meet older substation relays, suggesting increased engineering effort to achieve safe interoperability.

lenses.engineering: Expect additional relay coordination and possible gateway installations to manage mismatched control protocols.
